description: Average total payment value earned per unique customer. Measures how much each customer contributes to platform revenue.
Proportion of orders that were successfully delivered to the customer. Indicates logistics reliability and operational quality.
Mean customer satisfaction score across all reviewed orders. Scores range from 1 (worst) to 5 (best).
formula: AVG(review_score) WHERE review_score IS NOT NULL

description: Proportion of delivered orders where the actual delivery date exceeded the estimated delivery date. Lower is better.
formula: COUNT(order_id WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date) / COUNT(order_id WHERE order_status = 'delivered') * 100

description: Proportion of registered sellers that have fulfilled at least one order. Indicates how many sellers on the platform are actively contributing.
formula: COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id WHERE order_count >= 1) / COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) * 100

description: Freight value as a percentage of total order item price. High ratios indicate shipping is expensive relative to product value.
